name: question-navigator
title: Question navigator
description: A numbered grid for quizzes and long forms: answered, flagged, current and open questions differ in shape and words, with a summary and one tap to jump.
docs: Pass questions ({ id, label, state, flagged }), current and onSelect. state is unanswered or answered; flagged is separate, so a question can be both. A cell tells its state by shape: a dot for answered, a flag for flagged, an outline for the current one. Its name is one phrase: "Question 7, answered, flagged, current question". The summary above the grid ("Answered 14 of 20, 2 flagged") is a polite live region. The grid is one tab stop on the current cell; arrow keys move by a cell or a row, Home and End go to the ends of a row (with Control, to the first and last), Enter jumps. filter (all, unanswered, flagged) lists only those questions, set by you or with the buttons showFilter draws; an empty filter says so, and so does a list with no questions at all (labels.empty), instead of "Answered 0 of 0". columns is the most cells per row and a cell is never smaller than 2.5rem. showLegend draws the key. labels and locale translate.
